assessment: Six prior defects repaired and independently retested; normal sampling remains a failed implementation policy.

phase_disposition.overall_progress: Continue proposal alignment and share the demonstrated results with the known issues disclosed.
phase_disposition.blocker_status: No newly confirmed data-model blocker established by this audit. The reported prototype issues are follow-up work at this phase; pending proposal design choices retain their separate review status.
phase_disposition.claim_policy: Affected cases remain failed or unverified. Successful tested cases remain valid evidence. No whole-proposal conformance or complete implementation coverage claim follows.
phase_disposition.future_gate: Reassess each issue against the intended claim and delivery milestone. Stop only work dependent on genuinely unspecified meaning, while continuing independent work.
phase_disposition.model_policy: Repair against existing contracts first. Clarify truly missing semantics if needed; do not standardize an implementation workaround.

scope: Full local stacked follow-up, not the intentionally reduced terms/requirements baseline.

findings.classification: Undocumented observable consumer policy / unsupported approximation
findings.disposition: Do not promote the centroid workaround into the proposal. Derive transport from source normal/interpolation semantics and the full map; support the consumed domain with justified approximation evidence or visibly reject the unsupported result. Clarify only any remaining semantic ambiguity, independent of the shortcut.
findings.result_summary: Remaining: normal sampling has no justified domain/error bound; projected difference about 1.24 degrees.
findings.previous_finding: Both readers sample uniform face normals at the arithmetic mean of face vertices. They convert constant normals to per-vertex interpolation.
findings.finding: Remaining: normal sampling has no justified domain/error bound; projected difference about 1.24 degrees.
findings.previous_evidence: An analytic nonlinear-map counterexample has 8.4017-degree direction differences. An actual ENU/ECEF-to-UTM case has 1.24087-degree differences between the returned uniform normal and pointwise transported vertex normals. Both readers return success without an approximation domain or bound for this convention.

findings.classification: Implementation defect against an existing contract
findings.disposition: Repair the prototype classification/discovery path; this requires no new scene property or new scope deferral.
findings.result_summary: Corrected: an unbound library prototype receives its instancer placement in both readers.
findings.previous_finding: An unbound point-instancer prototype outside any CRS-bound subtree is rejected by both readers instead of using the instancer placement.
findings.finding: Corrected: an unbound library prototype receives its instancer placement in both readers.
findings.previous_evidence: A prototype at /Library/Proto and an instancer at /World/Model/Instances fail with No CRS binding in Python and the actual compiled C++ reader. The proposal-derived expected vertices are independently evaluated through the instancer.

findings.disposition: Make the export topology and geometry inventory exact, preserve each effect once, and reject unexpected extras in fresh-reader validation.
findings.result_summary: Corrected: two source meshes yield exactly two baked meshes; extras are rejected.
findings.previous_finding: Copying each geometry prim also copies its children, then independently exports those children again. The reread check compares only mapped Part roots and misses the extra geometry.
findings.finding: Corrected: two source meshes yield exactly two baked meshes; extras are rejected.
findings.previous_evidence: Two source triangles produce three exported triangles. The extra /Resolved/Part0/Child retains unconverted local geometry, while the exporter reports a successful fresh-read comparison of the two Part roots.

findings.disposition: Align by named dimensions before broadcasting. Both placement paths consume the same decoder, so their coordinate agreement cannot detect this defect.
findings.result_summary: Corrected: all six measurements retain the coordinates declared by dimension names.
findings.previous_finding: CF auxiliary-coordinate arrays are reshaped into data-variable order without first permuting their named dimensions. Measurement values become associated with different coordinates.
findings.finding: Corrected: all six measurements retain the coordinates declared by dimension names.
findings.previous_evidence: A measurement(y,x) with longitude(x,y) and latitude(x,y) has four of six samples assigned the wrong coordinate pair; decoding returns success.

findings.classification: Overbroad consumer export policy / collateral USD semantics loss
findings.disposition: Audit and preserve non-geospatial semantics, or explicitly reject/export only a documented supported subset. Do not silently treat every schema as a placement effect.
findings.result_summary: Corrected: the bake retains MotionAPI and its velocity-scale value.
findings.previous_finding: The exporter clears all applied schemas rather than removing only geospatial/dependency declarations no longer required by the derived copy.
findings.finding: Corrected: the bake retains MotionAPI and its velocity-scale value.
findings.previous_evidence: A source MotionAPI application disappears while its motion:velocityScale input remains authored. The exporter reports success. No documented target export profile justifies this broad deletion.

findings.classification: Incomplete result evidence against a specified reporting obligation
findings.disposition: Complete reporting from the existing output arrays without adding authored scene metadata.
findings.result_summary: Corrected: reports include component errors, magnitudes and angular errors.
findings.previous_finding: Comparison records report metric maxima but omit component residuals, coordinate magnitudes and separate geographic angular residuals.
findings.finding: Corrected: reports include component errors, magnitudes and angular errors.

findings.disposition: Add and exercise explicit role/scope validation in the build; distinguish validator coverage from the supported runtime path.
findings.result_summary: Corrected: both readers reject an invalid child placement field.
findings.previous_finding: Both runtime paths silently ignore an authored crs:position on an inherited-only mesh, even though the proposal declares those fields invalid there.
findings.finding: Corrected: both readers reject an invalid child placement field.
findings.previous_evidence: The invalid descendant field is accepted in the independent fixture. This demonstrates missing role/scope validation, not that every placement query is required to implement the complete validator.

findings.classification: Static audit concern; multiregion failure not reproduced in available resources
findings.finding: Python records only get_last_used_operation after a whole vector transform. This cannot establish per-point operation provenance when an engine selects different operations within one batch.
findings.evidence: The attempted regional fixture had two visible unavailable-operation failures and one available operation; it did not demonstrate omitted operations. Do not present this concern as a reproduced result failure.
findings.disposition: Require attributable operation coverage before claiming comparison of multiregion batches.

not_findings: Using instance index instead of authored instance ID is permitted by the candidate ID/index identity rule; the independent ID fixture is not evidence of a contract violation.

A documented 1mm comparison case, central differences, Richardson refinement, PROJ selection, caches and numeric recentering are implementation choices. Their algorithms need not be mandated by the proposal; their observable accuracy and contract obligations still apply.

Candidate transform, attitude, scene-chart, Profiles and export-context choices are explicitly proposed in the pinned document. They remain pending author agreement; that status is distinct from unspecified behavior.
General primvar and continuous nonlinear-domain coverage was already acknowledged as incomplete. It is not a new authored-data invention.
audit_failure_cause: The readiness gate verifies requirement numbers/titles, clause headings, hashes and a manually maintained semantic-gap ledger. It does not prove that each implementation branch follows a normative clause.
The reverse authored-field check detects extra property names but not private sampling rules, discarded USD metadata, wrong coordinate association or geometry inventory errors.
Python/C++ agreement misses shared policy and decoder mistakes. Existing normal evidence uses vertex normals and the prototype fixtures live under bound ancestry.
Fresh export verification did not compare the complete geometry/topology inventory.
conclusion: Revised leans define occurrence transport, ordinary bake inheritance, complete Profiles claims, geographic adjustment context, physical 3D metrics and ambiguous-half-turn outcomes. Fresh controls support these rules. A scoped audit cannot prove exhaustive completeness. Normal-domain approximation remains a prototype defect, and group adoption remains pending.
audit_binding: Fresh diagnostics checked every new frozen execution file and the actually executed native binary. Seven known issues reproduced; no runtime repairs claimed.
